description: S34 T1's roster read: who every agent is, first-party bodies and imported plugins alike, as identity only — never what they may do (tools.grants, T2's separate method) and never the four plugin state verbs, which stay CLI/app-only and unreachable from this socket (R6). State is the real vocabulary measured from the code, not a guess: first-party bodies answer "running" (plugin/import.go's literal, outside the store's own CHECK vocabulary entirely — first-party bodies run when their loop dispatches them), imported rows answer "disabled" / "enabled" / "revoked" (store/plugin_state.go's PluginAgentStates, the migration-0023 CHECK). There is no "blocked" and no "never_arrived" anywhere this reads from.
